name: rules.transfer

get.description: Read one native root detail online without changing a saved List.

lookup.name: ruleId
lookup.description: Native lookup sent as ruleId; use the unprojected List ruleId value.

result_identity.description: Native detail ruleId; exact nonempty string echo of the requested lookup.

purpose: Inspect native configuration through inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: ruleId
fields.meaning: Native row identity, retained without conversion.

limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant. Native fields, nested values, exact decimals and unknown fields are retained.
Single GET with fixed rowStart=0, pageSize=5000 and empty debitEntity/creditEntity arrays; no offset fallback.
All native conditions and nested values remain intact. SDK collection reports duplicates and count shortfall as incomplete; strict refresh publishes complete acquisitions only.

The qualified historical request width 5000 is a starting value, not a measured backend maximum. SDK conflict resolution keeps the last arrival and marks coverage incomplete; strict refresh preserves the prior cache on rejection.
Native Get uses GET query /queryTransferRuleDetail.json; lookup ruleId returns one native root object with ruleId.
Get preserves all native nested fields and unknown values; separately queried history, logs and child endpoints remain unqueried.
Get is live-only and publishes no cache or Duckdog data.

List --live --with-detail fetches native Detail only for the selected offset/limit window, returns separate record/detail members and fails atomically on any detail error; saved List data remains unchanged.

examples.title: Read one selected List row with its native detail

sync.evidence: Native ruleId identifies configuration rows. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.
